status: Design concepts only, not integrated into game currency logic.
requirements: Sunken and Saturnken each use one color family; Earthken may use blue and green

prompts.prompt:
Edit the provided Moonken coin image as the literal template for a NEW sibling coin. This is not a fresh style redesign: match the reference coin's exact circular silhouette, size, proportions, broad plain double rim, recessed face, orientation and especially its obvious chunky pixel grid. User rejected glossy ornate versions: make this MATTE, FLAT and SIMPLE, with almost NO SHINE. Use only a few subdued close-value shades, solid blocky pixel clusters, no gradients, no shiny metal reflections, no white highlights, no sparkle, no glow, no bloom, no bevel gloss, no tiny speckles, no texture noise. Keep just enough soft pixel shading to read the rim and a shallow stamped relief, like the craters on the reference. Enlarge an approximately 96x96-pixel native sprite cleanly using nearest-neighbor pixel edges, so pixels remain unmistakably visible. Preserve a clean continuous circular edge, no stray pixels. Transparent background with true alpha, entire coin visible with a transparent margin. ONE coin ONLY. No letters, no numbers, no labels, no face, no additional objects, no ground shadow.
Create EARTHKEN. Replace ONLY the crater pattern with a simple recognizable Earth face: broad blue oceans and large flat muted green land masses, not intricate cartography. Earth is the only exception to the single-color rule and may use blue plus green. The broad rim is muted green, with two slightly darker green shades for depth. The recessed ocean face is muted medium blue, with green continents stamped shallowly into it. Keep all the Earth motif within the same inner disk. No extra white ice caps or clouds. Calm flat colors, low contrast, almost no highlight.
